description: Operator in the Concierge channel asks about the status of an order for a customer who is already linked to the thread (shopifyCustomerId set). The agent should call get_shopify_orders directly using the linked ID - no need to search for the customer again.
whyModelNeeded: The model must use the linked conversational entity instead of redundantly searching for the customer.

messages.contentText: Pull the latest order status for this customer.

instruction: Pull the latest order status for this customer.
